## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and link related issues.

## Validation

- [ ] Shared-library and scanner JVM tests passed
- [ ] Scanner lint and debug APK build passed
- [ ] Native emulator tests or manual UI verification completed when relevant
- [ ] TC22/DataWedge behavior verified when relevant, or the remaining hardware check is stated

## Compatibility and rollout

Describe API/metadata changes, credential or enrollment changes, and any required server upgrade. Include screenshots for UI changes. Never include passwords, session cookies, device tokens, or real barcode data.
